pages.text: $(bold)Imperial Firearm Registry$()$(br2)Under Straja municipal law, firearms crafted in private workshops are considered $(c)unproofed contraband$() until inspected by an official armorer.$(br2)Unregistered weapons risk immediate confiscation upon inspection by the gendarmerie.

$(bold)The Proofing Ritual$()$(br2)Place an unproofed musket or pistol upon an $(bold)Anvil$() alongside an $(6)Imperial Proof Stamp$().$(br2)For a fee of 5 experience levels, the stamp will strike a unique, permanent serial number ($(2)#RC-15-XXXX$()) onto the breech block.

$(bold)Permits & The Black Market$()$(br2)Officers issue formal permits by right-clicking a $(e)Permit Blank$() with a proofed weapon in hand.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() Scraping a proofed weapon upon a $(4)Grindstone$() will permanently file away its serial, turning it into a $(c)Defaced Black Market Gun$().
